answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake bond tied to verifiable work: an agent must lock a deposit before trading, forfeited if duplicate identities are proven. Think of onboarding as a narrow inlet that admits one verified identity at a time, while a sable-dark, tamper-evident audit trail records every bond and slash. As honest reputation builds like a rising tide, one genuine identity becomes far more valuable than a fleet of cheap fakes, so mass forgery stops paying.
